text: Ag robotics and automation startups swarmed the news this week, coinciding with the FIRA 2024 farm robotics show in Sacramento, California. Agtonomy, Carbon Robotics, FarmDroid, and others all announced fundraises, while AgFunder portco Verdant Robotics unveiled a new AI-powered tractor implement and The Reservoir launched a new incubator concept for farm robotics. Beyond the ‘bots, advanced materials company Orbital Materials got backing from NVIDIA’s venture arm and Chilean foodtech NotCo unveiled a new AI-powered “fragrance formulator.” Foodtech funding 🇺🇸
